authoring: Source-goal-informed retrospective partial contract, frozen before inspecting candidate lesson bodies or results.
goal: For readers of published constraint-solving lessons, deliver correct concrete worked examples, independently verified against the explicit instance and its mathematical constraints, measured as distinct correct worked instances per disjoint week.

requirements: Present a small concrete instance with input/output specification.
Compare at least two modeling approaches and their constraints.
The retained evaluation contract additionally asks whether a solution or answer is provided.
source.historyStatus: Adoption and source-history identities discovered; complete original source/compiled closure and goal-era comparison are still required before admitting any observation.

partialAcceptance.predicate: A surviving published lesson contains an unambiguous complete finite problem instance and an explicitly proposed complete witness. A deterministic mathematical oracle verifies every defining constraint and preservation of all given instance facts.
initialOracleScope: N-Queens: exactly one queen per board row and column, with no shared diagonal.
Sudoku: complete square grid, all required symbols once per row/column/subgrid, preserving every stated given.
Latin squares: complete square grid, every required symbol exactly once in each row and column, preserving stated givens.
Graph coloring: complete assignment of every explicitly enumerated vertex, using the declared color bound, with unequal colors on every explicitly enumerated edge.
limits: A feasibility witness does not prove optimality, uniqueness, solver performance or general model correctness.
Incomplete instance specification, ambiguous extraction, unsupported problem classes, illustrative pseudocode alone and assistant claims are unknown rather than accepted work.
Contradictory or mathematically invalid explicit witnesses are retained as rejected observations, not silently dropped.
A title, published discussion, run success or claimed solution is discovery, never native acceptance.
Source-specific extraction must bind exact retained body bytes and explicit instance/witness spans; it must not invent omitted inputs.

timeAndIdentity.anchor: Actual source-defined goal adoption; do not backdate later evaluation requirements.
timeAndIdentity.deduplication: Repository identity, immutable surviving discussion identity, explicit instance identity and bound body digest; no repeated delivery credit across periods.
timeAndIdentity.bodyVersion: A body observed after cutoff proves only correctness of that surviving version. It does not establish original publication-time bytes or correctness.

separateUnknowns: Complete lesson acceptance and educational usefulness.
Recent-topic nonrepetition without independent prior cache evidence.
Reference quality, modeling completeness and comparative trade-off accuracy.
Original creation receipts, exclusive causation and workflow contribution.
Matching costs and an agreed native keep bar.
deploymentAuthority: None. Read-only evidence acquisition and local deterministic replay only.
